parameters.name: ProductType
parameters.description: The product type. Currently, only **ANT_CLOUD_AUTH** (financial-grade ID Verification) is supported. All other types have been discontinued.

sub_parameters.name: AccumulateWindow
sub_parameters.description: The size of the rate limiting statistical window, in minutes.

sub_parameters.name: ApiName
sub_parameters.description: The API name, which is the same as **ProductCode**.

sub_parameters.name: FlowType
sub_parameters.description:
The flow type. Valid values:
- **ACCUMULATE**: repeated occurrence of an ID card.
- **PASSED_RATE**: pass rate is less than.
- **SUB_CODE_205**: authentication failed and the proportion of liveness attack 205 is greater than.
- **SUB_CODE_206**: authentication failed and the proportion of liveness attack 206 is greater than.

sub_parameters.name: Status
sub_parameters.description:
The status. Valid values:
- **disabled**: disabled.
- **normal**: enabled.
